integrity: The mathematical upper bound and matching construction are both explicit; finite computations are supplementary and not used as proof of the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for a binary alphabet, input Hamming weight two and one deletion. Other weights, alphabet sizes, deletion counts and unrestricted cardinalities remain outside scope. Literature overlap remains a residual possibility; independent verification has not been performed.
title: Exact capacity of binary weight-two single-deletion codes
